notes: Reviewed against origin/main (17c597f); local main is stale, the PR is the single commit b982008 touching docs/API_MCP_GUIDE.md, server/internal/httpapi/mcp.go, mcp_relations_test.go, mcp_tool_docs_test.go.

Tests verified: both new tests in mcp_relations_test.go fail against the pre-change mcp.go (direction/source_asset/target_asset empty) and pass with it; TestMCPToolTableMatchesDeclaredSchemas passes and now compares the Scope column via t.Fatalf, so a wrong scope in the guide would fail it.

JOINs are safe: asset_relations.source_asset_id/target_asset_id are NOT NULL FKs to assets, and assets.name/type/status are NOT NULL, so no row is dropped and no NULL scan can occur. Delete (status='deleted'), merge (status='merged') and ingest/reconcile retirement (status='removed') all keep the assets row, so the counterpart's status is reported as documented.

server/internal/httpapi/mcp.go:757 direction uses a plain string compare `sourceID != input.AssetID`; asset_id is taken by RequiredString without UUID normalization. On Postgres an upper-case asset_id still matches rows (uuid compare) but the returned id text is lower-case, so every edge would be labelled 'inbound'. Narrow edge case (models normally echo the lower-case ids the server gave them; on SQLite the query simply returns nothing); strings.EqualFold or uuid.Parse normalization would close it.

docs/API_MCP_GUIDE.md:401 says asset_get misses counterparts whose status is deleted/merged; assets retired by ingest/reconcile carry status 'removed' with deleted_at set and are equally absent from asset_get. Doc is incomplete, not wrong.
Scope: the tool-table scope check in mcp_tool_docs_test.go is adjacent rather than required by the feature, but it is small, described in the commit message, and guards the doc row this change edits.
No migrations, auth, or external state touched; a revert restores the previous response shape (the UUID columns are unchanged, new keys are additive).
